claims.text: Adults ≥40 yrs on long-term glucocorticoids @ ↑ or very ↑frx risk: oral bisphos (strong rec).
claims.quote: A strong recommendation was made to use oral bisphosphonates (BPs) over no treatment for adults ≥40 years receiving long-term GCs, at high and very high risk for fracture
claims.locator: 2022 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for the Prevention and Treatment of Glucocorticoid-Induced Osteoporosis (guideline summary)
